sign_convention: dt_s = (t1 - ot1) - (t2 - ot2): travel time of event 1 (kma_id_1/rtdd_id_1) minus travel time of event 2 at that station; HypoDD dt.cc/dt.ct convention; rtDD: dt = dt_catalog - lag

column_descriptions.dt_s: differential travel time (s), event 1 minus event 2 (dt.cc: as written; dt.ct: TT1 - TT2)
column_descriptions.cc: cross-correlation coefficient written by the reference (also HypoDD's weight)
column_descriptions.weight: dt.ct weight (mean of the two .pha pick weights)
column_descriptions.tt1_catalog_s/tt2_catalog_s: catalog travel time = phase.csv pick - event.csv origin (= .pha travel time)
column_descriptions.dt_catalog_s: tt1_catalog_s - tt2_catalog_s (what dt.ct holds for this station/phase if ph2dt kept it)
column_descriptions.tt1_sac_s/tt2_sac_s: SAC header pick (phase_extra.sac_header_time) - origin: the picks the reference correlated around
column_descriptions.xcorr_shift_s: implied correction of event 1's pick by the reference cross-correlation: dt_s - (tt1_sac_s - tt2_sac_s)
column_descriptions.rtdd_equivalent_lag_s: the rtDD lag (xcorr.csv, same event order) that gives the same dt from the catalog picks: dt_catalog_s - dt_s
column_descriptions.in_dtct/dt_ct_s: the same pair/station/phase exists in dt.ct, and its TT1 - TT2
column_descriptions.kept_in_final_iteration/final_residual_m: listed in 02.dt.cc/hypoDD.res (the last of 28 iterations): kept, its residual (ms) and weight
column_descriptions.source_file/line_no: where the value was read (relative to data/gwangyang_11ev)
